i pay a 19 year old in the philippines $400/month to close $30k/month in DM sales for my info clients

and you're still personally responding to every single DM like a rtard

let me show you the arbitrage that's printing money while you're stuck being the bottleneck

here's the math that'll piss you off

cost: $400/month for full-time closer

revenue generated: $30,000/month average across clients

ROI: 75x

he closes deals while i sleep, while i'm with family, while i'm building other shit

i removed myself as the bottleneck and revenue went UP not down

because he's BETTER at closing than most of my clients were

and here's what makes you look stupid

you're charging $2k-5k for your info products

spending 2-3 hours per day in DMs "building relationships"

closing maybe 5-8 deals monthly yourself

doing $10k-15k monthly revenue

proud of yourself for "being hands-on with customers"

meanwhile i hired someone at $400/month who closes 8-12 deals monthly PER CLIENT

and i have 4 clients using this system

that's 32-48 deals monthly total

$120k+ in monthly revenue generated (split with clients obviously)

my cut for providing the system and the closer: $8k-12k monthly

his cut: $400/month + $50-100 bonuses per closed deal

everyone wins except you still doing everything yourself

"but singh i need to personally close deals to maintain quality"

no bro you need to personally close deals because you never built a SYSTEM

you're relying on your charisma and rapport instead of a repeatable framework

and charisma doesn't scale but SYSTEMS do

here's his exact script that closes $30k monthly

the framework has 5 stages and every message follows the structure

STAGE 1: THE QUALIFIER (first response when someone shows interest)

them: "hey interested in [your offer]"

script: "appreciate you reaching out bro. before i send details, quick question - what's your current situation with [specific problem your product solves]? trying to make sure this is actually a fit for where you're at"

why this works:
- doesn't immediately pitch (builds trust)
- qualifies them (saves time on tire kickers)
- gets them talking about their problem (pain awareness)
- frames you as selective (scarcity)

STAGE 2: THE AMPLIFIER (respond to their problem)

them: [explains their situation and problem]

script: "got it. so you're at [repeat their situation] and the main thing blocking you is [their stated problem]. that's exactly what [product name] solves.

real quick - have you tried [common solution they probably tried]? most people i work with have and it didn't work because [reason it fails]"

why this works:
- mirrors their language (rapport)
- shows you understood their problem (empathy)
- addresses failed solutions (removes objections preemptively)
- positions your offer as the NEW solution

STAGE 3: THE MECHANISM (explain what you do differently)

script: "here's how we do it differently:
instead of [old way that doesn't work], we [your specific mechanism]

basically you'll get:
[specific outcome 1] in [timeframe]
[specific outcome 2]
[specific outcome 3]

the process is [x] weeks and includes [brief deliverable list]

worked with [number] people in similar situation, here's what [name] said: [one sentence testimonial]"

why this works:
- mechanism creates differentiation
- specific outcomes create certainty
- timeframe creates urgency
- social proof removes risk

STAGE 4: THE TRANSITION (move to close)

script: "investment is [price].

based on what you told me about [their goal], if this gets you to [specific outcome related to their goal], that's worth way more than [price] right?

if you're ready to move forward i'll send payment link and we start [this week/monday/specific date]

any questions before we lock it in?"

why this works:
- states price directly (no games)
- immediately reframes to value (not cost)
- assumes the sale ("any questions before")
- creates urgency with start date

STAGE 5: THE OBJECTION HANDLER (if they hesitate)

common objection 1: "let me think about it"

script: "totally fair. what specifically do you need to think about? is it the price, the timeline, or something else? wanna make sure you have everything you need to make the decision"

then address the REAL objection they reveal

common objection 2: "is this really going to work for me?"

script: "i get it. here's the thing - [product] works if you [simple requirement like "follow the process" or "implement what's taught"].

the people who don't get results are the ones who [common failure behavior like "buy and don't implement"]

you seem serious about [their goal], so if you actually do the work, yeah it'll work.

that's why we have [guarantee] - if you [do the work] and don't [get result], i'll [refund/fix it/whatever your guarantee is]

that remove the risk for you?"

common objection 3: "can i do payment plan?"

script: "yeah we can do [X] payments of [amount].
or if you can do it in full there's a [small discount/bonus]
which works better for you?"

then send payment link for whichever they choose

the meta framework behind the script

the entire system works because it follows SPECIFIC PRINCIPLES:

principle 1: qualify before pitching

most people pitch immediately and waste time on people who'll never buy

script qualifies first, only pitches to qualified leads

principle 2: problem-focused not product-focused

script talks about THEIR problem 80% of the time

your solution 20% of the time

because people buy solutions to problems not products

principle 3: assume the sale

every message assumes they're moving forward

"any questions BEFORE we lock it in" not "do you want to buy"

language creates frame

principle 4: handle objections with questions

when they object, ask questions to uncover real objection

then address that specifically

most objections are smoke screens

principle 5: social proof at right moment

don't lead with testimonials (desperate)

insert them when explaining mechanism (credibility)
timing matters

why a $400/month VA executes this better than you

reason 1: he follows the script exactly

you freestyle and ramble because you think you're smart

he sticks to what works because he trusts the system

consistency beats creativity in sales

reason 2: he doesn't have ego attachment

when someone says no he moves to next lead

you take it personally and get in your feelings

he's running VOLUME while you're running FEELINGS

reason 3: he's available 12-16 hours daily

you check DMs twice a day between other tasks

he responds within 15 minutes every time

speed to lead wins deals

reason 4: it's his only job

you're juggling content, product creation, operations

he just closes DMs all day every day

focus creates mastery

reason 5: he has nothing to lose

if a deal doesn't close he just moves on

you stress about every lost sale because you're desperate

desperation kills sales, abundance wins

how to implement this yourself RIGHT NOW

step 1: hire the closer

upwork or onlinejobs(.)ph

post job: "DM Sales Closer for Info Products - $400/month + bonuses"

requirements:
- fluent english (test this in interview)
- available 10-12 hours daily
- experience not required (you'll train them)

hire someone hungry not experienced

experienced people have bad habits

step 2: give them the script

literally copy the framework i just gave you

customize it for your specific offer

make them practice on you until they can execute it perfectly

record loom videos showing examples

step 3: give them access

add them to your telegram/instagram/twitter DMs

set up auto-response: "thanks for reaching out, my team will respond within 15 mins"

they handle ALL inbound DM sales conversations

step 4: track everything

google sheet with columns:
- lead name
- date of first message
- current stage (qualifier/amplifier/mechanism/transition/close)
- objections raised
- outcome (closed/lost/follow-up)
- deal value

review weekly, optimize monthly

step 5: pay bonuses for results

base: $400/month

bonus: $50-100 per closed deal depending on deal size
this keeps them motivated and rewards performance
the economics that make this insane

if your closer generates even ONE $2k sale monthly

that's $2000 revenue for $400 cost

5x ROI minimum

but they'll actually close 8-12 deals monthly if your offer is decent

8 deals × $2000 = $16,000 monthly revenue

cost: $400 base + $400 in bonuses = $800 total

ROI: 20x

and you didn't touch a single DM

your time freed up to:
- create better products
- build more traffic
- scale the operation
- actually live your life

this is what LEVERAGE looks like bro

the objections and why you're wrong

"but my customers expect to talk to ME"

no they expect to talk to someone who can help them

if your VA follows the script they'll get better help than your distracted ass provides

"but what if they ask technical questions"

create FAQ doc with answers

VA handles 90% of questions

escalates complex ones to you via slack

you answer once, VA uses that answer forever

"but i can't afford $400/month"

if you can't afford $400 you can't afford NOT to do this

one extra sale pays for 2-5 months of their salary

and they'll generate way more than one sale
"but training someone sounds hard"

it's 4-6 hours of loom videos and 1 week of supervised practice

vs spending 2-3 hours DAILY in DMs forever

pick your hard

the meta advantage nobody talks about

when you remove yourself from sales you become more valuable

scarcity increases perceived value

"sorry, my team handles sales" sounds more premium than "yeah bro hop in my DMs"

you're positioning as operator not salesperson

operator > salesperson in status hierarchy

also you can scale infinitely

one VA closing $30k monthly for you at $400/month

what about 3 VAs closing $90k monthly at $1200/month total

or 10 VAs closing $300k monthly at $4k/month total

the math keeps mathing

meanwhile you're capped at your personal DM capacity

stop being the bottleneck

build the system

hire the closer

scale the revenue

i build info product businesses for people who have knowledge but no infrastructure. if that's you, DM "ARBITRAGE" @singhscales
